resourceRule: One fresh model invocation per cell after deterministic precondition preparation; B0/B1/B2/B3/P share model, tools, grader, mutation authority, and workspace state.
specialistPoolRule: B2/B3/P use the same non-generalist worker pool frozen in ontology-stress-baselines-v0.3. B0 alone uses the strong generalist.
hypotheses: On covered contract-change controls, B3 and P should usually route similarly because the frozen ontology contains contract_interpreter.

On ontology-stress scenarios, the frozen B3 role selector should have zero direct context coverage for the novel state dimensions, while P may route to worker-forensics or worker-external-state through those dimensions.
Any performance or correctness difference must be reported together with actual worker-selection divergence; timing differences without routing divergence are not evidence for Need emergence.

analysisPlan.counterbalance: cyclic baseline order rotation across replicate, task, and scenario
analysisPlan.uncertainty: paired bootstrap interval for latency deltas; exact paired outcomes for success

freezeRules: No task, grader, stateRequirement, role, worker profile, matcher weight, context mapping, or role-selector semantics may change after the first real-agent v0.3 outcome is inspected.
Any semantic bug fix creates v0.3.1 and requires rerunning every affected cell.
v0.2 remains a separate prospective null/ceiling result and is never replaced by v0.3.
B3 and P must use the same specialist worker pool and capability+situatedness matcher.
A v0.3 claim about Need emergence requires observed B3/P worker-selection divergence in the stress cells.
